title: Agricultural Botany
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ may be defined as the unit of matter that has hair like dimension and length may be 200 times greater than the width."
Fibre may be defined as the unit of matter that has hair like dimension and length may be 200 times greater than the width.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is considered to be allogamous female and male flowers rarely bloom together."
Oil palm is considered to be allogamous female and male flowers rarely bloom together.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are known with yellow, orange, pink and green fruits besides the familiar red types."
Tomatoes are known with yellow, orange, pink and green fruits besides the familiar red types.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the highest classificatory group and of one of the three division of living world that comprises of a large diversity of plant ranging from lower and simpler to the higher and complex form."

Plant kingdom is the highest classificatory group and of one of the three division of living world that comprises of a large diversity of plant ranging from lower and simpler to the higher and complex form.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the central axis of the tuber, forming a continuous connection from the stem end to the apical eye and to the buds in each eye."
The inner medulla is the central axis of the tuber, forming a continuous connection from the stem end to the apical eye and to the buds in each eye.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the commonest sugar producing crop that can be better comprehended by students in terms of familiarities and cultivation."
Sugar cane is the commonest sugar producing crop that can be better comprehended by students in terms of familiarities and cultivation.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a basic phenomenon of osmosis."
Diffusion is a basic phenomenon of osmosis.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is composed of organisms that resemble one another in many important characteristics."
A species is composed of organisms that resemble one another in many important characteristics.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are derived from the apical meristems of the stem and the root, and the secondary permanent tissues from the lateral meristems, i.e. cambial layers."
The primary permanent tissues are derived from the apical meristems of the stem and the root, and the secondary permanent tissues from the lateral meristems, i.e. cambial layers.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the female whorl differentiated into the ovary, style and stigma."
Gynoecium or pistil is the female whorl differentiated into the ovary, style and stigma.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is known as diwakawaka or ear palm because of its ear shaped fruits which are due to the presence of flower organs that have evolved into oil producing tissue."
Poissonii is known as diwakawaka or ear palm because of its ear shaped fruits which are due to the presence of flower organs that have evolved into oil producing tissue.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the spore-bearing leaves concerned in asexual reproduction of plants."
Sporophylls - are the spore-bearing leaves concerned in asexual reproduction of plants.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the earliest sciences since man started using plant as a source of food and medicine."
Botany is one of the earliest sciences since man started using plant as a source of food and medicine.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is called the flag and its sheath enfolds and protects the developing panicle."
The upper leaf is called the flag and its sheath enfolds and protects the developing panicle.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a caryopsis as in other grasses."
The small seed is a caryopsis as in other grasses.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is that which develops from a number of flowers juxtaposed together, or in other words, from an inflorescence."
Multiple - A is that which develops from a number of flowers juxtaposed together, or in other words, from an inflorescence.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the lateral appendages of the leaf born at its base. 5."
Stipules - are the lateral appendages of the leaf born at its base. 5.
fib: ______ is composed of thick, central axis carrying some 200 spikes, on each of which develop some 700-800 tightly packed flowers.
male inflorescence
The male inflorescence is composed of thick, central axis carrying some 200 spikes, on each of which develop some 700-800 tightly packed flowers.
______ is the male whorl and each of its stamen differentiated into filament, anther and connective.
androcoecium
The androcoecium is the male whorl and each of its stamen differentiated into filament, anther and connective.
______ is the genus to which it belongs.
generic name
The generic name is the genus to which it belongs.
______ is the back bone of man's existence.
Agriculture
Agriculture is the back bone of man's existence.
______ is the source of energy utilized in photosynthesis.
Light
Light is the source of energy utilized in photosynthesis.
______ is an elongated oblong, indehiscent pod, containing one to three seeds (occasionally up to six), constricted slightly between the seeds.
fruit
The fruit is an elongated oblong, indehiscent pod, containing one to three seeds (occasionally up to six), constricted slightly between the seeds.
______ is the least expensive, but most important of all bast fibres and comes second in production only to cotton among all the natural fibres.
Jute
Jute is the least expensive, but most important of all bast fibres and comes second in production only to cotton among all the natural fibres.
______ is a conducting tissue and is composed of elements of different kinds, viz. (i) tracheids, (ii) bassels or tracheae (sin, trachea), (iii) wood fibres, and (iv) wood parenchyma.
Xylem or wood
Xylem or wood - is a conducting tissue and is composed of elements of different kinds, viz. (i) tracheids, (ii) bassels or tracheae (sin, trachea), (iii) wood fibres, and (iv) wood parenchyma.
______ is the art of growing and selling, dressing and arranging flowers and foliage plants.
Floriculture
Floriculture is the art of growing and selling, dressing and arranging flowers and foliage plants.
______ is the short, greatly enlarged apical portion of the stolon, full of stored food.
tuber
The tuber is the short, greatly enlarged apical portion of the stolon, full of stored food.
______ is the difference between the diffusion pressure of pure water and that of water in solution at the same temperature.
DPD
DPD is the difference between the diffusion pressure of pure water and that of water in solution at the same temperature.
______ is the major and essential photosynthetic and is coloured bluish green while chlorophyll b is olive/yellow green.
Chlorophylls a
Chlorophylls a is the major and essential photosynthetic and is coloured bluish green while chlorophyll b is olive/yellow green.
______ is called 'rough rice' or 'paddy', while that with the hull removed is known as 'brown', 'husked' or 'cleaned' rice.
Rice invested in the hull
Rice invested in the hull is called 'rough rice' or 'paddy', while that with the hull removed is known as 'brown', 'husked' or 'cleaned' rice.
______ is the first detectable stable organic compound formed during the fixation of CO2 by the mechanism.
PGA
PGA is the first detectable stable organic compound formed during the fixation of CO2 by the mechanism.
______ is the seat of food-manufacture for the entire plant.
Lamina
Lamina is the seat of food-manufacture for the entire plant.
______ is one of man's oldest occupations and probably began when he discovered that certain seeds spilled on disturbed ground grew in some mysterious way into new plants.
cultivation of plant
The cultivation of plant is one of man's oldest occupations and probably began when he discovered that certain seeds spilled on disturbed ground grew in some mysterious way into new plants.
